integrity: The minimality and normal forms are proved symbolically and independently replayed by exhaustive enumeration of every anonymous profile and every homogeneous support change through seventeen voters.
scientific_limitations: Complete for three candidates, complete strict ballots, tie-independent unique outcomes, and homogeneous groups that all make the same winner-raising change. Heterogeneous coalitions and larger candidate sets are outside the theorem.
title: Complete minimal homogeneous monotonicity classification for three-candidate instant runoff
